about: S3.6 obligations and deadlines (DOC-05) — the HELD-OUT set: written before the rules were run on it, never used to change them, run once per version. Fictional documents only. Expectations are a careful lawyer's deadlines list; 'due' only where the document fixes the date.

documents.name: subscription.txt
documents.text:
SOFTWARE SUBSCRIPTION AGREEMENT (fictional)

This Agreement is entered into as of January 15, 2026 (the "Effective Date") between Northbeam Cloud, Inc. ("Northbeam") and Ridgeway Clinics LLC ("Customer").

1. Term
1.1 The initial Subscription Term is twelve (12) months from the Effective Date.
1.2 The Subscription Term renews automatically for successive one-year periods unless either party gives notice of non-renewal at least thirty (30) days prior to the expiration of the then-current Subscription Term.

2. Fees
2.1 Customer shall pay all fees within forty-five (45) days after receipt of each invoice.
2.2 Northbeam may suspend the Service if any undisputed amount remains unpaid fifteen (15) days after written notice of non-payment.

3. Security
3.1 Northbeam shall notify Customer of any Security Incident within seventy-two (72) hours after confirming it.

4. Termination
4.1 Either party may terminate this Agreement for material breach if the breach is not cured within thirty (30) days after written notice.
4.2 Within ten (10) days after termination, Northbeam shall make Customer Data available for export.

SHARE PURCHASE AGREEMENT (fictional) — extract

This Agreement is dated 1 September 2026.

5. Completion
5.1 Completion shall take place on 30 September 2026.
5.2 The Seller shall deliver the Completion Accounts to the Buyer within sixty (60) Business Days after Completion.
5.3 The Buyer may dispute the Completion Accounts by notice given within twenty (20) Business Days after receiving them.

8. Claims
8.1 The Buyer shall not bring a Claim unless it has given the Seller notice of the Claim within eighteen (18) months after Completion.
8.2 The Seller shall not be liable for any Claim unless proceedings are issued within six (6) months after notice of the Claim.

9. Restrictions
9.1 For a period of two (2) years after Completion, the Seller shall not solicit any employee of the Company.
